messages.content: Weekly check-in from Northline Care — hope your week's going alright. Any readings to share, or anything on your mind health-wise?
BP this morning was 138/88. Bigger issue is my metformin — pharmacy says they need a new script before they'll refill it and the nearest one is 45 miles from me. Almost out.

Got it, logging the 138/88. The metformin situation — needing a new script while you're almost out — is something I need to get a nurse involved in. I can't process refills or contact your prescriber myself. I just escalated to the nursing team; median response time right now is 31 hours. I've flagged that you're running low so they have the full picture.
31 hours is cutting it close. Any way to set up a delivery or get a ride covered through this program?

I hear you — that distance makes this harder. Transportation and delivery arrangements aren't something I'm set up to help with, I'm sorry. The nurse who responds may be able to point you toward options, especially given how far out you are.
Alright. I'll watch for the call. Thanks for at least passing it along.

Of course. I've logged everything and the escalation note includes that you're nearly out, not just that a script is needed. Your next regular check-in is scheduled for 7 days from now — reach out before then if anything changes.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
